2585-5660-6769-6797.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2585-5660-6769-6797.description:
Cast Grim Monolith by paying its mana cost.
When Grim Monolith enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Grim Monolith, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Grim Monolith from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

3682-5660-6769-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one colored legendary creature or planeswalker.
Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3682-5660-6769-8095.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying its mana cost.
When Mox Amber enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding one mana of any color among legendary creatures and planeswalkers you control.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Mox Amber, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mox Amber from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

2226-3977-5921.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-3977-5921.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Fractured Realm.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Horned Kavu by paying its mana cost.
When Horned Kavu enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

222-527-4742-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4742-8249.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Defiant Salvager twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

4279-6559-6887--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-6559-6887--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Venerated Stormsinger, The Skullspore Nexus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus ability, creating a X/X Fungus creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Venerated Stormsinger triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

822-3488-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Roar of the Kha is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
822-3488-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
822-3488-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Katsumasa.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Roar of the Kha without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Roar of the Kha, untapping all creatures you control
Repeat from step 2.

728-2586-4186.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Odric's Outrider triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability
Repeat

969-1395-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska and Elsha's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn
Resolve the Vraska trigger, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

101-225-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
101-225-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Vampire Charmseeker and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Vampire Charmseeker and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve a Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining trigger.
Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
Repeat steps 6 through 9 once.
Repeat from step 1.
101-225-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Vampire Charmseeker and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

4682-5184-7890.notablePrerequisites: At least two opponents cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
4682-5184-7890.description:
Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {2}{W}, causing two opponents to each draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers twice, creating four Treasure tokens due to Xorn
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have near-infinite Treasure tokens, you may repeat the loop targeting yourself as one of the players in step 1, drawing any number of cards.

1322-6723-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1322-6723-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1322-6723-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

2557-4659-5086-5183-7743.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2557-4659-5086-5183-7743.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

527-542-7297.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
527-542-7297.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1308-2097-4682-5140.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
1308-2097-4682-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Jolene and Anointed Procession.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
1308-2097-4682-5140.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

3532-3761-4985-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3761-4985-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Arcbound Crusher triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Crusher.
Repeat.

4131-4222-4720-6657.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {6} and tapping it, copying Basalt Monolith's ability three times.
Resolve a copy of Basalt Monolith's ability, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 4 two additional times.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Gogo.
Repeat from step 3.

796-1762-2511.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional Zombie creature.
796-1762-2511.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by  sacrificing a Zombie creature.
Wilhelt triggers, creating a 3/3 Zombie token with no abilities due to Poppet Factory.
Resolve the ability from step 1.
Repeat.

729-2136.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{R}.
729-2136.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {1}{R}.
Activate Orthion's first ability by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Great Oak Guardian with haste.
When the Great Oak Guardian token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

4659-5365-5494-5902.notablePrerequisites:
Innkeeper's Talent is level 3.
You control at least one additional artifact
4659-5365-5494-5902.description:
Activate Lonis by paying {2} and sacrificing another artifact.
If the artifact was a Clue, Lonis' third ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Lonis ability, putting two +1/+1 counters on it and causing you to draw a card.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Lonis' third ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on any other creature you control.
Repeat.

186-2416-4131.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
186-2416-4131.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Cast Rise and Shine by paying {1}{U}, making Basalt Monolith a 0/0 artifact creature and putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {2}, untapping it.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

1794-4424-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one black card in hand.
1794-4424-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Ruthless Ripper.
When Ruthless Ripper dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Ruthless Ripper from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Ruthless Ripper's power.
Activate Ruthless Ripper's morph ability by revealing a black card from your hand, turning it face up.
Ruthless Ripper triggers, causing target player to lose 2 life.
Repeat.

851-1645-1765-4050.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}, targeting any creature you control.
When Crown of Flames enters the battlefield, Chishiro triggers, creating two 2/2 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Spirits, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames' second ability by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1692-3492-3609.notablePrerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to Coretapper.
1692-3492-3609.description:
At the beginning of combat on your turn, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Coretapper with haste.
Activate the token Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate the token Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2034-2567-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Avenger of Zendikar, adding {C}{C}.
When Avenger of Zendikar dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Avenger of Zendikar from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Avenger of Zendikar enters, it triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

544-1176.notablePrerequisites:
Estrid and Estrid has at least two loyalty counters.
Enchanted permanents you control are able to tap for at least {4}{W}{U}{G}.
544-1176.description:
Activate Estrid's second loyalty ability by removing one loyalty counter, creating a Mask Aura token and attaching it to Sanctum of Eternity.
Activate Sanctum of Eternity by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Estrid to your hand.
Activate all other enchanted permanents that can produce at least {4}{W}{U}{G}.
Cast Estrid by paying {1}{W}{U}{G}.
Activate Estrid's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, untapping all enchanted permanents you control.
